Collecting reliable history

Forecasting needs a 30-day venue baseline. A Court Pick also needs at least eight comparable occurrences of the same weekday and hour.

How Pickle Street decides

Future reservations affect upcoming capacity, not demand history. Only paid or downpayment-paid confirmed/completed court sessions through yesterday teach demand. Failed payments, temporary holds, cancelled or forfeited bookings, pre-opening dates, blocked dates, Maintenance, and Open Play are excluded. Recent comparable weeks carry more weight. Current saved schedules are applied to historical capacity, so review Insights after major operating-hour changes.

PLATFORM ACCESS & BOOKING FEE AUTHORIZATION AGREEMENT
Pickleball Court Booking System — Version 13 · Inclusive Price Allocation & Remittance Terms

Read the full agreement before signing. The Sign button unlocks only after you scroll to the bottom.

1. Parties

Platform Provider: [Platform Provider / System Owner Legal Name] ("Platform Provider"), the developer, system owner, and administrator of the Pickleball Court Booking System, a software platform that enables customers to discover and book pickleball courts online.

Court Owner: The individual or business identified by the account below ("Court Owner"), who independently owns, operates, and is solely responsible for the physical Pickle Street Tugbok venue identified in the court owner account.

The Platform Provider does not own, manage, staff, price, or operate the physical court. The Platform Provider provides the online booking software and related platform services only.

2. What the Platform Provides

While this Agreement remains active, the Platform Provider grants the Court Owner access to the following at no setup fee, one-time fee, monthly subscription fee, hidden fee, or any other platform charge to the Court Owner:

  • Online court booking page accessible to the public
  • Real-time slot availability management
  • Automated GCash receipt fraud detection and verification
  • Admin dashboard for managing bookings, courts, and staff accounts
  • Automated customer notifications and booking references
  • Platform hosting, security, and technical maintenance

3. Embedded Booking Fee Allocation & Accumulated Remittance

In consideration of the platform access provided at no setup fee, one-time fee, monthly subscription fee, hidden fee, or other platform charge to the Court Owner, the Court Owner authorizes the Platform Provider to allocate the current System Owner-selected booking fee from within the Court Owner's configured player-facing price for each eligible transaction.

The configured court price is the complete amount shown to and paid by the customer. The booking fee allocation is not added on top at checkout. The System Owner sets the allocation amount and charging method, either per booked hour or per confirmed booking transaction, and the system privately records the allocation in the booking-period remittance statement.

When it applies. The configured booking fee allocation applies only to a confirmed booking transaction that successfully reserved a court slot. Bookings that are released before confirmation, expire, or never hold a slot do not create a remittance allocation.

Collection. The Court Owner collects the complete displayed price from the customer. From that collected amount, the configured booking fee allocation is held on behalf of the Platform Provider until remittance; the remainder is the Court Owner's net court revenue. No additional booking fee is charged to the player.

Accumulated remittance every 14th. Eligible booking fees accumulate continuously until the Court Owner prepares remittance on the 14th day of the month. At that moment, the system freezes an exact server-recorded cutoff in Asia/Manila time and creates a permanent snapshot of all eligible, unsettled confirmed booking transactions available before that cutoff. Each booking is included only once. Eligible bookings at or after the cutoff begin the next accumulated balance for the following 14th.

Due date & method. The accumulated balance is scheduled for remittance on the 14th of each month. The Court Owner prepares the exact cutoff, remits the frozen amount via GCash to the booking fee remittance account shown in the dashboard, and submits the transaction reference and receipt screenshot. The remittance becomes Settled only after the System Owner verifies the proof; its permanent record remains available in Remittance History.

Non-remittance. Statements not remitted past the due date are marked overdue. The Platform Provider may suspend or restrict the Court Owner's access to the booking system until all outstanding statements are settled. Suspension does not waive any amounts already due.

4. Court Owner's Revenue

The Court Owner controls the complete player-facing court price. For each eligible confirmed booking, the configured booking fee allocation is deducted from that collected price for the Platform Provider; the balance belongs exclusively to the Court Owner as net court revenue. The player never pays the allocation as an additional checkout charge.

5. Anti-Circumvention

The Court Owner agrees not to direct, encourage, or assist customers to bypass the platform in order to avoid the configured booking fee allocation. This includes but is not limited to: advertising a direct booking channel at a lower price for platform-visible slots, accepting bookings verbally or via personal chat for slots available on the platform, or instructing customers to "book directly" to avoid the allocation.

Circumvention of the booking fee allocation is a material breach of this Agreement and may result in immediate suspension or termination of platform access.

6. Obligation to Honor Bookings

The Court Owner agrees to honor all confirmed bookings made through the platform. Customers who receive a booking confirmation with a reference number must be allowed access to the court at the reserved date and time. Cancellations caused by the Court Owner's failure to honor a confirmed booking are a breach of this Agreement.

7. Court Owner's Responsibilities

  • Keep court availability, rates, and operating hours accurate on the platform
  • Manage and respond to customer concerns about the physical court experience
  • Ensure the court is safe, operational, and accessible during booked hours
  • Keep remittance references and receipt screenshots accurate and truthful
  • Keep admin login credentials confidential and not share access with unauthorized persons
  • Not export or misuse customer data for purposes unrelated to court management

8. Independence of Parties

The Court Owner and Platform Provider are fully independent parties. This Agreement does not create a partnership, franchise, joint venture, employment, or agency relationship. The Platform Provider is not responsible for:

  • Disputes between the Court Owner and customers
  • Physical injuries or accidents at the court
  • Loss of revenue due to court downtime or customer cancellations
  • Any business, tax, or legal obligations of the Court Owner

9. Platform Availability

The Platform Provider will make reasonable efforts to keep the system available. However, the Platform Provider does not guarantee 100% uptime and is not liable for losses caused by temporary platform outages, third-party service interruptions (e.g. Supabase, Cloudflare), or force majeure events.

10. Termination

Either party may terminate this Agreement with 14 days written notice by email or another written channel recorded by both parties. The Platform Provider may suspend access or terminate immediately if the Court Owner breaches Sections 5 (Anti-Circumvention) or 6 (Honor Bookings), fails to remit overdue booking fees, engages in fraud, or misuses customer data.

11. Governing Law

This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Republic of the Philippines, including the Electronic Commerce Act of 2000 (RA 8792), the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173), and the Civil Code of the Philippines. Any disputes shall be resolved in the proper courts of Cagayan de Oro City, Misamis Oriental.

12. Acceptance by Electronic Signature

Pursuant to the Philippine Electronic Commerce Act of 2000 (Republic Act No. 8792), this Agreement is legally binding upon electronic acceptance. By typing your legal full name and drawing your signature below and clicking "I Agree & Sign", you confirm that:

  • You have read and fully understood all terms of this Agreement.
  • You are the authorized Court Owner or duly authorized representative.
  • You authorize the platform to allocate the System Owner-selected booking fee from within the complete player-facing price on confirmed booking transactions.
  • You agree to remit the continuously accumulated booking fees to the Platform Provider on the 14th of each month, using the exact cutoff recorded when remittance is prepared.
  • You agree to honor all platform bookings and not circumvent the booking fee.
  • You understand the Platform Provider is the software provider only and does not operate the court.
  • This electronic signature has the same legal force as a handwritten signature under RA 8792.
